binary_build.cargo_toml:
[package]
name = "fast-spektrafilm"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.93"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"
description = "Memory-efficient Rust implementation of spektrafilm's experimental pipeline"
default-run = "fast-spektrafilm"

[features]
default = ["bundled-libraw"]
bundled-libraw = []
gui = ["dep:slint", "dep:slint-build", "dep:rfd"]

[[bin]]
name = "fast-spektrafilm-gui"
path = "src/bin/gui.rs"
required-features = ["gui"]

[lib]
name = "fast_spektrafilm"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
rayon = "1"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }
toml = "0.8"
libm = "0.2"
half = "2"
tiff = "0.10"
slint = { version = "=1.18.1", optional = true, default-features = false, features = ["std", "backend-winit", "renderer-software", "compat-1-18"] }
rfd = { version = "0.17.2", optional = true }
tempfile = "3"
rustfft = "6"
nalgebra = "0.34"
exr = "1"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg", "tiff", "webp", "exr"] }
lcms2 = "6"
libloading = "0.8"

[build-dependencies]
cc = { version = "1", features = ["parallel"] }
pkg-config = "0.3"
slint-build = { version = "=1.18.1", optional = true }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1

gui_binary_build.cargo_toml:
[package]
name = "fast-spektrafilm"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.93"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"
description = "Memory-efficient Rust implementation of spektrafilm's experimental pipeline"
default-run = "fast-spektrafilm"

[features]
default = ["bundled-libraw"]
bundled-libraw = []
gui = ["dep:slint", "dep:slint-build", "dep:rfd"]

[[bin]]
name = "fast-spektrafilm-gui"
path = "src/bin/gui.rs"
required-features = ["gui"]

[lib]
name = "fast_spektrafilm"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
rayon = "1"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }
toml = "0.8"
libm = "0.2"
half = "2"
tiff = "0.10"
slint = { version = "=1.18.1", optional = true, default-features = false, features = ["std", "backend-winit", "renderer-software", "compat-1-18"] }
rfd = { version = "0.17.2", optional = true }
tempfile = "3"
rustfft = "6"
nalgebra = "0.34"
exr = "1"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg", "tiff", "webp", "exr"] }
lcms2 = "6"
libloading = "0.8"

[build-dependencies]
cc = { version = "1", features = ["parallel"] }
pkg-config = "0.3"
slint-build = { version = "=1.18.1", optional = true }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
